outputs.explanation: Panel A is a single representative spatial transcriptomics cluster map from one lung section; no replicated/quantified data with statistics is presented.
Panel B shows representative H&E images with manual region annotation from the same single section shown in A; no quantification or replicate-based statistics are presented.
Panel C shows representative H&E and spatial gene-expression heatmap images from the single section; no quantified/replicated summary statistics are presented.

replicate_statements: GSEA from T11b-high versus low squamous tumors (S1&S2 versus S3) with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and P values
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: This panel presents statistical comparisons (NES, FDR, P values) between tumor regions derived from a single tissue section. The '1000 permutations' refers to the GSEA statistical resampling procedure, not the number/type of biological or experimental replicates (e.g., number of sections, animals, or spots) underlying the comparison, which is not stated.

replicate_statements: Bar graph representing top squamous genes/oncogenes from differential gene expression (DEG) analysis of Tmprss11b-high versus low LUSC spatial transcriptomics data
Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction
outputs.explanation: The panel reports fold-change and P values from a statistical test comparing high vs low regions, but the number and type of replicates (e.g., spots, sections, or animals compared) underlying the DEG/Wilcoxon analysis are not stated in the legend.
